review:
Bash Bros features Oskar and Fred, two brothers who smash the grid. Cash symbols expand upward into Cash Stacks with bet multipliers of up to 10,000x, and all stacks on the grid add their values together.

Once the grid settles with at least one stack showing, Oskar may knock a reel out and replace it with a new Cash Stack, or Fred may squash the stacks together and double their multipliers. The Bros Before Blows bonus increases stack frequency, and the cap is 10,000x.
